startTile: the same parameter of findBfsPathToTile, whose search this function repeats statement for statement (the two differ in the goal test and in the fallback); with the same names a diff of the two shows only that
currentX: the same local of findBfsPathToTile: the tile taken from the queue
currentY: the same local of findBfsPathToTile: the tile taken from the queue
currentGridX: the same local of findBfsPathToTile: that tile's index in the cost grid
currentGridY: the same local of findBfsPathToTile: that tile's index in the cost grid
directionIndex: the same local of findBfsPathToTile: the index into pathfindNeighborOffsets, cardinalBlockFlags and pathfindBacktrackFlags
bestDistanceSquared: the same local of findBfsPathToTile's fallback: the least squared distance found so far
bestCost: the same local of findBfsPathToTile's fallback: the step cost of the tile with that distance

energy: it is player.specialAttack.energy read before the inputs of the tick are applied, and its one use is the argument of runPlayerUpkeep(tick, previousTick, specialAttackEnergyAtTickStart); the same function reads the run energy as player.runEnergy.energy
